description: Runs bigin-lint's invariant checks after a write into a Bigin requirements vault, so an ID collision, a malformed signal-table row, a broken citation, or an illegal status value is caught at the moment it lands rather than by a verification pass that a context-pressured run can skip. Exits silently and immediately in any repo that has no _bigin/system/project.md, so it is inert outside a Bigin project.
